title: ASL | No Determination | OAL Data Not Available | 14-Day Polling Exhausted | Manual Handling
description:
Israel-destination multi-leg (YYZ?FRA?TLV). AC leg (Leg 1 YYZ?FRA) completed on time. OAL leg (Leg 2 LH 694 FRA?TLV, Lufthansa operated) was disrupted but Lufthansa's flight data has NOT been received through OAG feeds within the 14-day window. AC's own data is complete but the partner airline's data is unavailable. Without OAL timing data, DDS cannot determine actual arrival at TLV or whether the delay was caused by AC or Lufthansa. ASL counterpart to APPR TC_073 (ND-06) and EU TC_145 equivalent.

PNR: single passenger Shira Abramov (Adult). Journey: 2 legs: Leg 1 AC 873 YYZ?FRA (AC operated � data AVAILABLE, on time); Leg 2 LH 694 FRA?TLV (Lufthansa operated � data NOT AVAILABLE). MSL: Leg 2 (OAL, disrupted, data missing). AC leg data: Complete. OAL leg data: NOT RECEIVED from OAG feeds within 14-day window (data-sharing gap for this specific flight). 14-day retry: EXHAUSTED. Regime: ASL (TLV destination) + APPR. Residence: Israel.
